<style>

.echo-consent { 
--ink:#172b41; 
--blue:#005eb8;

.echo-consent, .echo-consent * { box-sizing:border-box; }
.echo-consent .logos { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; margin-bottom:32px; }
.echo-consent .logos img { height:auto; object-fit:contain; max-width:100%; }
.echo-consent .nhs { width:290px; } .echo-consent .university { width:200px; } .echo-consent .study { width:76px; }
.echo-consent h1 { color:var(--ink); font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.35rem); line-height:1.2; margin:0 0 24px; }

.echo-consent .notice p:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
.echo-consent label { font-weight:600; display:block; }
.echo-consent input { display:block; width:100%; max-width:100%; min-width:0; font:inherit; line-height:1.4; color:var(--ink); background:#fff; border:1px solid #70859a; border-radius:4px; padding:10px 12px; min-height:46px; margin-top:7px; }
.echo-consent input:disabled { opacity:1; color:var(--ink); -webkit-text-fill-color:var(--ink); cursor:default; }
.echo-consent input:focus-visible, .echo-consent button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffdd00; outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #172b41; }
.echo-consent .study-id { max-width:720px; margin:24px 0; }
.echo-consent .column-head { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 210px; gap:24px; padding:12px 20px; background:var(--ink); color:#fff; font-weight:bold; }
.echo-consent fieldset { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 210px; gap:24px; min-width:0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding:24px 20px; margin:0; }
.echo-consent fieldset:nth-of-type(even) { background:#f6f8fb; }
.echo-consent legend { float:left; width:100%; padding:0; font-weight:bold; margin:0 0 8px; }

.echo-consent .statement-copy p:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
.echo-consent .responses { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px; align-content:start; }
.echo-consent .responses label { font-size:.95rem; }
.echo-consent .responses input { text-align:center; }
.echo-consent .signature-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:24px; }
.echo-consent .signature-grid label { margin:0; }
.echo-consent .wide { grid-column:1 / -1; }
.echo-consent .version { font-size:.85rem; color:#465b70; border-top:1px solid var(--border); margin-top:32px; padding-top:16px; }
.echo-consent button { font:inherit; font-weight:600; color:white; background:var(--blue); border:0; border-radius:4px; padding:12px 20px; cursor:pointer; margin-top:20px; }
@media(max-width:1300px) {

<div class="study-details">
<p><strong>Study Title:</strong> 
Digital recordings of heart sounds in babies during the Newborn Infant Physical Examination
</p>

<p><strong>Short title:</strong> 
The babyPHONO study
</p>

<p><strong>
Chief Investigator:</strong> Dr. Neil Lawrence
</p>

<p><strong>
Principal Investigator:</strong> Dr. Simon Clark
</p>
</div>

<p>
If you wish for your child to take part in ‘The babyPHONO study’, please read the participant information sheet (PIS_babyPHONO_echo_v2.0). 

Please write your initials next to each statement in the right-hand column below ‘yes’ if you agree or below ‘no’ if you do not agree, and sign and date the form at the end.</p>

<label class="study-id" for="study-id">Participant Study Identification Number<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="study-id" name="study-id" type="text" autocomplete="off"></label>

<div class="column-head" aria-hidden="true"><span>Consent statement</span><span>Your initials</span></div>

<fieldset aria-labelledby="statement-1"><div class="statement-copy"><p id="statement-1"><strong>Statement 1</strong></p>

<p>
I confirm that I have read the relevant participant information sheet [PIS_babyPHONO_ECHO_v2.0] for the above study. I have had the opportunity to consider the information, ask questions and have had these answered satisfactorily.
</p>

</div><div class="responses">

<label for="s1-yes">initial here for no:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s1-yes" name="s1-yes" type="text" aria-label="Initial for YES to statement 1" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

<label for="s1-no">initial here for yes:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s1-no" name="s1-no" type="text" aria-label="Initial for NO to statement 1" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

</div></fieldset>

<fieldset aria-labelledby="statement-2"><div class="statement-copy"><p id="statement-2"><strong>Statement 2</strong></p>

<p>
I understand that taking part in this study will involve:
</p>

<p>
a) The recording of my child’s heart sounds using a digital stethoscope
</p>

<p>
b) The recording of my child’s heart rate, respiratory rate, and blood oxygen levels
</p>

<p>
c) The completion of a short paper survey paper after (a) and (b) above
</p>

<p>
d) The storing of pseudonymised images from my baby’s echocardiogram for purposes of research analysis (pseudonymised means their personal details like name and date of birth will be removed)
</p>

<p>
e) (a), (b), (c) and (d) above repeated if my child has a repeat echocardiogram before 3 months of age
</p>

<p>
f) A follow-up telephone call after my child is 1 year of age to check if my child has been diagnosed with any heart conditions. This call will likely take less than 20 minutes.
</p>

</div><div class="responses">

<label for="s2-yes">
initial here for no:
<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s2-yes" name="s2-yes" type="text" aria-label="Initial for YES to statement 2" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

<label for="s2-no">initial here for yes:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s2-no" name="s2-no" type="text" aria-label="Initial for NO to statement 2" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

</div></fieldset>

<fieldset aria-labelledby="statement-3"><div class="statement-copy"><p id="statement-3"><strong>Statement 3</strong></p>

<p>
I understand that participation of my child is voluntary and that I am free to withdraw my child at any time without giving any reason, without my medical care or legal rights being affected.
</p>

</div><div class="responses">

<label for="s3-yes">initial here for no:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s3-yes" name="s3-yes" type="text" aria-label="Initial for YES to statement 3" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

<label for="s3-no">initial here for yes:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s3-no" name="s3-no" type="text" aria-label="Initial for NO to statement 3" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

</div></fieldset>

<fieldset aria-labelledby="statement-4"><div class="statement-copy"><p id="statement-4"><strong>Statement 4</strong></p>

<p>
I understand that by choosing to participate as a volunteer in this research, this does not create a legally binding agreement nor is it intended to create an employment relationship with the University of Sheffield
</p>

</div><div class="responses">

<label for="s4-yes">initial here for no:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s4-yes" name="s4-yes" type="text" aria-label="Initial for YES to statement 4" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

<fieldset aria-labelledby="statement-5"><div class="statement-copy"><p id="statement-5"><strong>Statement 5</strong></p>

<p>
If I decide to withdraw my child from the study, I understand no further data will be collected. I understand that the research team can withdraw my data from the study, unless it has already been aggregated, shared or published in which case it will not be possible to withdraw my data.
</p>

</div><div class="responses">

<label for="s5-yes">initial here for no:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s5-yes" name="s5-yes" type="text" aria-label="Initial for YES to statement 5" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

<label for="s5-no">initial here for yes:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s5-no" name="s5-no" type="text" aria-label="Initial for NO to statement 5" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

</div></fieldset>

<fieldset aria-labelledby="statement-6"><div class="statement-copy"><p id="statement-6"><strong>Statement 6</strong></p>

<p>
I understand that identifiable data (such as name) and relevant sections of my child’s medical notes and/or data collected during the study may be reviewed by responsible individuals from the research team, the Sponsor (the University of Sheffield), the NHS Trust, or from regulatory authorities. I give permission for these individuals to have access to my child’s records. The purpose of this access will be to establish the age of the baby (in hours) at each assessment, and to download images from echocardiogram scans from hospital systems after they’ve taken place.
</p>

</div><div class="responses">

<label for="s6-yes">initial here for no:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s6-yes" name="s6-yes" type="text" aria-label="Initial for YES to statement 6" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

</div></fieldset>

<fieldset aria-labelledby="statement-7"><div class="statement-copy"><p id="statement-7"><strong>Statement 7</strong></p>

<p>
I understand and agree that anonymised data about my child may be used in publications, reports, presentations, web pages, and other research outputs. I understand that this anonymised and aggregated data will be available indefinitely, but that my child will not be identifiable in these outputs.
</p>

</div><div class="responses">

<label for="s7-yes">initial here for no:<input readonly disabled tabindex="-1" id="s7-yes" name="s7-yes" type="text" aria-label="Initial for YES to statement 7" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>

</p>

<fieldset aria-labelledby="statement-10"><div class="statement-copy"><p id="statement-10"><strong>Statement 10</strong></p>

<p>
